svg.aria-label: Each of the five analysis kinds asserts a fixed set of statements and reads the solver's reply in a fixed way. Consistency is satisfied when the solver answers sat. Contradiction, implication, redundancy and dead antecedent assert a negation, so unsat means satisfied and sat is a counterexample.
